doc: SPEC ĐÓNG BĂNG — Thần Số Học Pythagoras (Decoz / California School). Engine phải khớp spec này. KHÔNG trộn Chaldean / Millman / biểu đồ mũi tên 3×3 vào pipeline chính.

rules.life_path: Reduce month, day, year SEPARATELY (keep master), then sum and reduce (keep master). Never digit-string shortcut.
rules.expression_soul_personality: Reduce EACH name part separately (keep master), then sum part totals and reduce. Never sum all letters of the full name in one pass for intermediate values.
rules.challenges: Reduce month/day/year WITHOUT keeping master, then absolute differences. Challenge 3 is Main.
rules.pinnacles: Use month/day/year reduced WITH master kept. Age band 1 ends at (36 − life_path_as_single_digit).
rules.period_timing: Period 1 duration = 36 − LP(single digit); Period 2 = exactly 27 years; Period 3 = remainder of life.
rules.y_rule: Y is vowel when not adjacent to another pure vowel (A/E/I/O/U). W is always consonant.
rules.vietnamese_name_order: Default name_order=vn: tokens = [Họ, …Đệm, Tên]. Decoz 'first name' = Tên (last token); 'last name' = Họ (first token); middle = đệm tokens. western: first/middle/last as English order.
rules.minor_numbers: Same formulas on current_name (tên đang dùng), not birth name.
